scope: Latest fully paginated MARSCOIN ERC20 wallet in/out activity over 29 distinct historical transaction/block events. Includes 2026 source records beyond the earlier 23-wallet matrix scan. All 29 native BNB balance deltas are direct original chain state, but this is not a verified final isolated per-token realized PnL.
method: Classify original onchain tx.from as owner, other or UNRESOLVED; do not count external/unknown receipt as owner signed; native block net from eth_getBalance before and after N, preserve unknown receipt status, strict big integers and ERC20 token balance residual.

discrepancy_from_older_matrix.explanation: The earlier limited scan omitted relevant transfer records. Preserve older matrix as dated historical evidence, refresh derived wallet comparison using current full pagination.

limitations: Six original tx payloads truncate before their signer; do not promote as owner signed
11 receipt headers unavailable/truncated; original ERC20 event inclusion confirms chain execution of event, but not independent explicit receipt status
Wallet-native N-1 to N delta can contain unrelated same-block native activity; only 2 token CA route tracing was done for other wallet
Latest residual tokens not marked zero or assigned unsupported USD value
Full market universe and independent wallet control not established
